reviews.text: Roland's dog training was an extraordinary success. I didn't think it would be possible to make this much progress so quickly and I thought our dog may not manage. Roland's course is excellent though. In particular it focusses on training dogs for real world environments where there are distractions and there's lots of opportunity to socialise with other dogs. Couldn't recommend it enough! Definitely give it a go.
Finishing my 5 week course with roland for the third time with 3 different puppies. Very informative and classes are good fun

Just recently I contacted the London Dog Training Centre to arrange a session for our sprollie puppy, Millie, who is now ten months old. Although we are pleased with her behaviour, she still pulls hard on the lead. To be honest we’ve tried every leash going or we thought we had. After asking a few questions, Roland advised we use a figure-of-eight lead. Let me just say it’s a game-changer and for the first time Millie has walked without pulling and her head up. It’s early days I know, and it may not work for everyone, but that phone call has, for the first time, made dog-walking a pleasure.  Thank you Roland, we will be seeing you soon.

Very effective training, the classes teach you stuff that is actually really useful, like recall and walking nicely on and off the lead. Our miniature dachshund puppy took to the classes very well, and learned everything very quickly. The trainer is happy to answer any questions and help with your individual problems, and gives very useful advice.

Top notch advice and honesty! Had a call where he gave me great advice and told me (correctly) that my issue didn't require buying a bunch of sessions -- when other dog trainers were trying to sell me packages for thousands of dollars.

Extremely helpful, Roland is an amazing and experienced trainer. We did our five weeks puppy class for our Whippet, and I really recommend it. He shared a lot insights but also it has been a good way for our puppy to socialise with other dogs.

Roland was brilliant with our little sausage pup Ralphie, helping him to master recall and all the essential tips and tricks to help develop him. Classes were also great for socialisation. Would strongly recommend!!

Absolutely phenomenal training, personal approach and care shown throughout the course. Roland’s advice worked very well for us, first time puppy owners with a very picky eater puppy. We’re looking forward to keep learning more.

Roland has been an exceptional trainer! He has not only managed to nail down the basics of puppy training such as recalls, reward training etc, but also assisted us with the individual issues that we’d been experiencing at home. He offered simple and effective solutions which helped with training our puppy away from the class. Overall, I couldn’t recommend Roland enough.

Two of our dogs now have gone through Roland's puppy school. Brilliant, wise and full of common sense, I would recommend his classes (and do), to anyone wanting to have the best possible relationship with their dog. Recall, toilet training, bad behaviour training all wrapped up in one course and both our puppies loved the experience.

Very informative course that not only covered dog training. Roland is very experienced.
Also learnt useful information on feeding, toilet training etc.
I would recommend course.

Roland has some great techniques for dealing with common issues in puppy training, such as recall, leaving things alone, walking by your side toilet training, and really anything that you’re having problems with. The classes are fun, and a great way to socialise a young dogs.

Roland’s dog training course has been fantastic in so many ways. Firstly, Miley has been able to develop by training with and socialising with other dogs. Secondly, we have been given lots of tools to use to help us with the training and we can see how Miley has developed. Thirdly it has forced my kids to get out of bed early because they enjoy the training as much as Miley!
We would highly recommend Roland!

My two kids and I and our two working black labs had a combination of a brief private training session at home, followed by participation in group classes and we could not be happier. Roland provides a host of cost effective practical tips and tricks, has a “safety first“ approach - for the safety of the dog, children and adults. His classes are light hearted, effective and enjoyable and I would gladly recommend him to anyone. In fact on walks in the local parks we often came across other dog owners who had also had dog training from Roland, and they were all extremely happy with the training and sending best wishes back to Roland. Truly a fist class dog trainer.
For new and returning dog owners, Roland provides an excellent grounding in  doggy control and behaviour. Our new puppy has benefited immensely...thank you Roland
We have found Roland to be an expect dog trainer. He knows exactly what he is doing and is always helpful answering any of our queries. We strongly recommend Rowland he tells it straight no frills.
Great sessions. Really helped us!
Roland is really great and was super helpful with a home visit and his classes. Highly recommend.

Roland has provided excellent advice and guidance in helping us to raise our young pup. He has been at the end of the phone and happy to answer any questions and queries or simply to put our minds at rest.

That's all outside the actual training sessions! As for these, they have been invaluable in establishing routines, socialising with other puppies and stopped me feeling like a failure in hearing that others were experiencing the same challenges.

I think they are excellent value for money and already feel sad that there are only 2 left!!

Thank you Roland - you've made this journey more enjoyable with your excellent insight and cannot believe the difference we can see in our own pup and the others in the class already!!

Roland is a great trainer, he’s very patient, knowledgeable and clearly loves the dogs he trains. We did both puppy class and a few ad-hoc Gundog classes with our spaniel Lucie, and it put her training far in advance of other puppies her age.
